test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A car and a bus were both travelling in the same direction. At 7.30 a.m., the car, moving at 72 km/h, was 4.2 kilometres behind the bus. The car was 15.8 kilometres ahead of the bus at 8:15 a.m. What is the ratio of the speed of the car to that of the bus?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Speed of car = 72 km/h

Distance covered by car in 1 hour i.e. 60 minutes = 72 km

Distance covered by car in 45 minutes (from 7 : 30 a.m to 8 : 15 a.m) = 54 km [i.e. (72/60) × 45]

Distance covered by bus in 45 minutes = (54 - 4.2 - 15.8) km = 34 km

When time is constant then,

The speed of the car ∶ The Speed of the Bus = Distance covered by car ∶ Distance covered by bus in 45 minutes = 54 ∶ 34

27 ∶ 17
